verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this product, because it ships a software stack (Ryzen AI Software, Lemonade SDK, GAIA) alongside the silicon. However, no evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out control. GAIA's local-by-default inference and air-gapped deployment support is a related privacy posture, not a documented opt-out from telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
